module encoder_64b66b (
    input  logic         clk_in,              // Clock signal
    input  logic         rst_in,              // Asynchronous reset (active high)
    input  logic [63:0]  encoder_data_in,     // 64-bit data input
    input  logic [7:0]   encoder_control_in,  // 8-bit control input
    output logic [65:0]  encoder_data_out     // 66-bit encoded output
);

    logic [1:0]  sync_word;
    logic [63:0] encoded_data;

    // Sync header: active-high asynchronous reset
    always_ff @(posedge clk_in or posedge rst_in) begin
        if (rst_in) begin
            sync_word <= 2'b00;
        end
        else begin
            if (encoder_control_in == 8'b00000000) begin
                sync_word <= 2'b01;         // data mode
            end
            else begin
                sync_word <= 2'b10;         // control mode
            end
        end
    end

    // Encoded payload: active-high asynchronous reset
    always_ff @(posedge clk_in or posedge rst_in) begin
        if (rst_in) begin
            encoded_data <= 64'b0;
        end
        else begin
            if (encoder_control_in == 8'b00000000) begin
                encoded_data <= encoder_data_in;  // data mode: pass data
            end
            else begin
                encoded_data <= 64'b0;            // control mode: clear payload
            end
        end
    end

    assign encoder_data_out = {sync_word, encoded_data};

endmodule

module barrel_shifter #(
    parameter data_width = 16,
    parameter shift_bits_width = 4
)(
    input  [data_width-1:0]       data_in,
    input  [shift_bits_width-1:0] shift_bits,
    input  [2:0]                  mode,
    input                         left_right,
    input  [data_width-1:0]       mask,
    input                         enable,
    input                         enable_parity,
    input  [data_width-1:0]       condition,
    input  [1:0]                  bit_op_type,
    output reg [data_width-1:0]   data_out,
    output reg                    parity_out,
    output reg [1:0]              error
);

always @(*) begin
    if (!enable) begin
        data_out   = data_out;   // hold previous value when disabled
        error      = 2'b00;
        parity_out = 1'b0;
    end else begin
        error = 2'b00;
        case (mode)
            3'b000: begin  // logical shift
                if (shift_bits >= data_width) begin
                    error    = 2'b10;  // out-of-range shift
                    data_out = {data_width{1'b0}};
                end else if (left_right) begin
                    data_out = data_in << shift_bits;
                end else begin
                    data_out = data_in >> shift_bits;
                end
            end
            3'b001: begin  // arithmetic shift
                if (shift_bits >= data_width) begin
                    error    = 2'b10;  // out-of-range shift
                    data_out = {data_width{1'b0}};
                end else if (left_right) begin
                    data_out = data_in << shift_bits;
                end else begin
                    data_out = $signed(data_in) >>> shift_bits;
                end
            end
            3'b010: begin  // rotate
                if (shift_bits >= data_width) begin
                    error    = 2'b10;  // out-of-range shift
                    data_out = {data_width{1'b0}};
                end else if (left_right) begin
                    data_out = (data_in << shift_bits) | (data_in >> (data_width - shift_bits));
                end else begin
                    data_out = (data_in >> shift_bits) | (data_in << (data_width - shift_bits));
                end
            end
            3'b011: begin  // masked shift
                if (shift_bits >= data_width) begin
                    error    = 2'b10;  // out-of-range shift
                    data_out = {data_width{1'b0}};
                end else if (left_right) begin
                    data_out = (data_in << shift_bits) & mask;
                end else begin
                    data_out = (data_in >> shift_bits) & mask;
                end
            end
            3'b100: begin  // add / subtract
                if (left_right) begin
                    data_out = data_in + shift_bits;
                end else begin
                    data_out = data_in - shift_bits;
                end
            end
            3'b101: begin  // find-first-set (priority)
                data_out = 0;
                for (int i = data_width-1; i >= 0; i = i - 1) begin
                    if (data_in[i] == 1 && data_out == 0) begin
                        data_out = i;
                    end
                end
            end
            3'b111: begin  // conditional bit manipulation
                case (bit_op_type)
                    2'b00: data_out = data_in ^ condition;   // toggle
                    2'b01: data_out = data_in | condition;   // set
                    2'b10: data_out = data_in & ~condition;  // clear
                    default: begin                            // invalid operation
                        data_out = {data_width{1'b0}};
                        error    = 2'b01;
                    end
                endcase
            end
            default: begin  // reserved / invalid mode (e.g. 3'b110)
                data_out = {data_width{1'b0}};
                error    = 2'b01;  // invalid mode
            end
        endcase
    end

    if (enable_parity) begin
        parity_out = ^data_out;
    end else begin
        parity_out = 1'b0;
    end
end

endmodule

module gf_multiplier (
    input [7:0] A,     // Multiplicand
    input [7:0] B,     // Multiplier
    output reg [7:0] result // Result
);
    reg [7:0] temp_result;
    reg [8:0] multiplicand;
    reg [8:0] irreducible_poly = 9'b100011011; // Irreducible polynomial x^8 + x^4 + x^3 + x + 1

    integer i;

    always @(*) begin
        temp_result = 8'b00000000; // Initialize result to zero
        multiplicand = {1'b0, A}; // Initialize multiplicand, adding an extra bit to handle overflow

        // Perform multiplication using shift-and-add algorithm
        for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
            if (B[i]) begin
                temp_result = temp_result ^ multiplicand[7:0]; // XOR the multiplicand with result
            end
            multiplicand = multiplicand << 1; // Shift the multiplicand left by 1
            if (multiplicand[8]) begin
                multiplicand = multiplicand ^ irreducible_poly; // Polynomial reduction if overflow occurs
            end
        end

        result = temp_result; // Output the final result
    end
endmodule

module line_buffer #(
    parameter NBW_DATA  = 'd8,  // Bit width of grayscale input/output data
    parameter NS_ROW    = 'd10, // Number of rows
    parameter NS_COLUMN = 'd8,  // Number of columns
    parameter NBW_ROW   = 'd4,  // log2(NS_ROW). Bit width of i_image_row_start
    parameter NBW_COL   = 'd3,  // log2(NS_COLUMN). Bit width of i_image_col_start
    parameter NBW_MODE  = 'd3,  // Bit width of mode input
    parameter NS_R_OUT  = 'd4,  // Number of rows of the output window
    parameter NS_C_OUT  = 'd3,  // Number of columns of the output window
    parameter CONSTANT  = 'd255 // Constant value to use in PAD_CONSTANT mode
) (
    input  logic                                  clk,
    input  logic                                  rst_async_n,
    input  logic [NBW_MODE-1:0]                   i_mode,
    input  logic                                  i_valid,
    input  logic                                  i_update_window,
    input  logic [NBW_DATA*NS_COLUMN-1:0]         i_row_image,
    input  logic [NBW_ROW-1:0]                    i_image_row_start,
    input  logic [NBW_COL-1:0]                    i_image_col_start,
    output logic [NBW_DATA*NS_R_OUT*NS_C_OUT-1:0] o_image_window
);

// ----------------------------------------
// - Wires/Registers creation
// ----------------------------------------
logic [NBW_DATA-1:0] image_buffer_ff [NS_ROW][NS_COLUMN];
logic [NBW_DATA-1:0] row_image [NS_COLUMN];
logic [NBW_DATA-1:0] window [NS_R_OUT][NS_C_OUT];
logic [NBW_DATA*NS_R_OUT*NS_C_OUT-1:0] image_window_ff;

// ----------------------------------------
// - Output generation
// ----------------------------------------
always_comb begin : window_assignment
    case(i_mode)
        3'd0: begin // NO_BOUND_PROCESS
            for (int row = 0; row < NS_R_OUT; row++) begin
                for (int col = 0; col < NS_C_OUT; col++) begin
                    if(i_image_row_start + row >= NS_ROW) begin
                        window[row][col] = 0;
                    end else if (i_image_col_start + col >= NS_COLUMN) begin
                        window[row][col] = 0;
                    end else begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[i_image_row_start + row][i_image_col_start + col];
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        3'd1: begin // PAD_CONSTANT
            for (int row = 0; row < NS_R_OUT; row++) begin
                for (int col = 0; col < NS_C_OUT; col++) begin
                    if(i_image_row_start + row >= NS_ROW) begin
                        window[row][col] = CONSTANT;
                    end else if (i_image_col_start + col >= NS_COLUMN) begin
                        window[row][col] = CONSTANT;
                    end else begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[i_image_row_start + row][i_image_col_start + col];
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        3'd2: begin // EXTEND_NEAR
            for (int row = 0; row < NS_R_OUT; row++) begin
                for (int col = 0; col < NS_C_OUT; col++) begin
                    if(i_image_row_start + row >= NS_ROW) begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[NS_ROW-1][i_image_col_start + col];
                    end else if (i_image_col_start + col >= NS_COLUMN) begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[i_image_row_start + row][NS_COLUMN-1];
                    end else begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[i_image_row_start + row][i_image_col_start + col];
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        3'd3: begin // MIRROR_BOUND
            for (int row = 0; row < NS_R_OUT; row++) begin
                for (int col = 0; col < NS_C_OUT; col++) begin
                    if(i_image_row_start + row >= NS_ROW) begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[2*NS_ROW-1-(i_image_row_start + row)][i_image_col_start + col];
                    end else if (i_image_col_start + col >= NS_COLUMN) begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[i_image_row_start + row][NS_COLUMN-1-(i_image_col_start + col)];
                    end else begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[i_image_row_start + row][i_image_col_start + col];
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        3'd4: begin // WRAP_AROUND
            for (int row = 0; row < NS_R_OUT; row++) begin
                for (int col = 0; col < NS_C_OUT; col++) begin
                    if(i_image_row_start + row >= NS_ROW) begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[(i_image_row_start + row)-NS_ROW][i_image_col_start + col];
                    end else if (i_image_col_start + col >= NS_COLUMN) begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[i_image_row_start + row][(i_image_col_start + col)-NS_COLUMN];
                    end else begin
                        window[row][col] = image_buffer_ff[i_image_row_start + row][i_image_col_start + col];
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        default: begin
            for (int row = 0; row < NS_R_OUT; row++) begin
                for (int col = 0; col < NS_C_OUT; col++) begin
                    window[row][col] = 0;
                end
            end
        end
    endcase
end

// ----------------------------------------
// - Input control
// ----------------------------------------
generate
    for (genvar col = 0; col < NS_COLUMN; col++) begin : unpack_row_image
        assign row_image[NS_COLUMN-col-1] = i_row_image[(col+1)*NBW_DATA-1-:NBW_DATA];
    end
endgenerate

always_ff @(posedge clk or negedge rst_async_n) begin : ctrl_regs
    if(~rst_async_n) begin
        image_window_ff <= 0;
        for (int row = 0; row < NS_ROW; row++) begin
            for (int col = 0; col < NS_COLUMN; col++) begin
                image_buffer_ff[row][col] <= 0;
            end
        end
    end else begin
        if(i_valid) begin
            for (int col = 0; col < NS_COLUMN; col++) begin
                image_buffer_ff[0][col] <= row_image[col];
            end

            for (int row = 1; row < NS_ROW; row++) begin
                for (int col = 0; col < NS_COLUMN; col++) begin
                    image_buffer_ff[row][col] <= image_buffer_ff[row-1][col];
                end
            end
        end

        if(i_update_window) begin
            image_window_ff <= o_image_window;
        end
    end
end

// ----------------------------------------
// - Output packing
// ----------------------------------------
generate
    for(genvar row = 0; row < NS_R_OUT; row++) begin : out_row
        for(genvar col = 0; col < NS_C_OUT; col++) begin : out_col
            always_comb begin
                if(i_update_window) begin
                    o_image_window[(row*NS_C_OUT+col+1)*NBW_DATA-1-:NBW_DATA] = window[row][col];
                end else begin
                    o_image_window[(row*NS_C_OUT+col+1)*NBW_DATA-1-:NBW_DATA] = image_window_ff[(row*NS_C_OUT+col+1)*NBW_DATA-1-:NBW_DATA];
                end
            end
        end
    end
endgenerate

endmodule : line_buffer

module morse_encoder (
    input  wire [7:0] ascii_in,
    output reg  [9:0] morse_out,
    output reg  [3:0] morse_length
);

    // Morse code: dot (.) = 0, dash (-) = 1. Right-aligned within the 10-bit field.
    // morse_length gives the number of valid low bits in morse_out.
    // Uppercase letters A-Z and digits 0-9 are supported; all else -> 0 / 0.
    always @(*) begin
        case (ascii_in)
            8'h41: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000001; morse_length = 4'd2; end // A .-
            8'h42: begin morse_out = 10'b0000001000; morse_length = 4'd4; end // B -...
            8'h43: begin morse_out = 10'b0000001010; morse_length = 4'd4; end // C -.-.
            8'h44: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000100; morse_length = 4'd3; end // D -..
            8'h45: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000000; morse_length = 4'd1; end // E .
            8'h46: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000010; morse_length = 4'd4; end // F ..-.
            8'h47: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000110; morse_length = 4'd3; end // G --.
            8'h48: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000000; morse_length = 4'd4; end // H ....
            8'h49: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000000; morse_length = 4'd2; end // I ..
            8'h4A: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000111; morse_length = 4'd4; end // J .---
            8'h4B: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000101; morse_length = 4'd3; end // K -.-
            8'h4C: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000100; morse_length = 4'd4; end // L .-..
            8'h4D: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000011; morse_length = 4'd2; end // M --
            8'h4E: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000010; morse_length = 4'd2; end // N -.
            8'h4F: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000111; morse_length = 4'd3; end // O ---
            8'h50: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000110; morse_length = 4'd4; end // P .--.
            8'h51: begin morse_out = 10'b0000001101; morse_length = 4'd4; end // Q --.-
            8'h52: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000010; morse_length = 4'd3; end // R .-.
            8'h53: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000000; morse_length = 4'd3; end // S ...
            8'h54: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000001; morse_length = 4'd1; end // T -
            8'h55: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000001; morse_length = 4'd3; end // U ..-
            8'h56: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000001; morse_length = 4'd4; end // V ...-
            8'h57: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000011; morse_length = 4'd3; end // W .--
            8'h58: begin morse_out = 10'b0000001001; morse_length = 4'd4; end // X -..-
            8'h59: begin morse_out = 10'b0000001011; morse_length = 4'd4; end // Y -.--
            8'h5A: begin morse_out = 10'b0000001100; morse_length = 4'd4; end // Z --..
            8'h30: begin morse_out = 10'b0000011111; morse_length = 4'd5; end // 0 -----
            8'h31: begin morse_out = 10'b0000001111; morse_length = 4'd5; end // 1 .----
            8'h32: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000111; morse_length = 4'd5; end // 2 ..---
            8'h33: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000011; morse_length = 4'd5; end // 3 ...--
            8'h34: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000001; morse_length = 4'd5; end // 4 ....-
            8'h35: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000000; morse_length = 4'd5; end // 5 .....
            8'h36: begin morse_out = 10'b0000010000; morse_length = 4'd5; end // 6 -....
            8'h37: begin morse_out = 10'b0000011000; morse_length = 4'd5; end // 7 --...
            8'h38: begin morse_out = 10'b0000011100; morse_length = 4'd5; end // 8 ---..
            8'h39: begin morse_out = 10'b0000011110; morse_length = 4'd5; end // 9 ----.
            default: begin morse_out = 10'b0000000000; morse_length = 4'd0; end
        endcase
    end

endmodule

module alu_seq (
    input i_clk,          // Clock signal
    input i_rst_b,        // Active-low asynchronous reset
    input [3:0] i_operand_a, // 4-bit input operand A
    input [3:0] i_operand_b, // 4-bit input operand B
    input [2:0] i_opcode,    // 3-bit operation code
    input [7:0] i_key_in,    // 8-bit security key input
    output reg [7:0] o_result // 8-bit operation result
);

    // Configurable internal 8-bit security key, default 0xAA
    parameter [7:0] p_key = 8'hAA;

    always @(posedge i_clk or negedge i_rst_b) begin
        if (!i_rst_b) begin
            // Active-low asynchronous reset: clear result
            o_result <= 8'b0;
        end else begin
            if (i_key_in == p_key) begin
                // Key matches: perform the selected operation
                case (i_opcode)
                    3'b000: o_result <= i_operand_a + i_operand_b;      // Addition
                    3'b001: o_result <= i_operand_a - i_operand_b;      // Subtraction
                    3'b010: o_result <= i_operand_a * i_operand_b;      // Multiplication
                    3'b011: o_result <= i_operand_a & i_operand_b;      // Bitwise AND
                    3'b100: o_result <= i_operand_a | i_operand_b;      // Bitwise OR
                    3'b101: o_result <= ~i_operand_a;                   // Bitwise NOT of A
                    3'b110: o_result <= i_operand_a ^ i_operand_b;      // Bitwise XOR
                    3'b111: o_result <= ~(i_operand_a ^ i_operand_b);   // Bitwise XNOR
                    default: o_result <= 8'b0;
                endcase
            end else begin
                // Key mismatch: no operation, result remains 0
                o_result <= 8'b0;
            end
        end
    end

endmodule

`timescale 1ns / 1ps

module sync_lifo #(
    parameter DATA_WIDTH = 8,  // Width of the data
    parameter ADDR_WIDTH = 3   // Number of bits for the address (determines the depth)
)(
    input wire clock,                         // System clock
    input wire reset,                         // Synchronous reset
    input wire write_en,                      // Write enable
    input wire read_en,                       // Read enable
    input wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] data_in,      // Data input to be written into LIFO
    output wire empty,                        // Indicates if LIFO is empty
    output wire full,                         // Indicates if LIFO is full
    output wire [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] data_out,    // Data output from LIFO
    output reg  error,                        // High on invalid op (overflow/underflow)
    output reg  valid                         // High when data_out holds valid read data
);

    // Calculate depth of the LIFO using the address width
    localparam DEPTH = (1 << ADDR_WIDTH);      // Depth = 2^ADDR_WIDTH

    // Registers for LIFO logic
    reg [DEPTH-1:0] ptr;                       // Pointer for write/read operations
    reg [DEPTH-1:0] lifo_counter;              // Counter to track the number of elements in the LIFO
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] memory [DEPTH-1:0];   // Memory array to store LIFO data
    reg [DATA_WIDTH-1:0] temp_data_out;        // Temporary register for output data

    // Output assignments for empty and full flags
    assign empty = (lifo_counter == 0) ? 1'b1 : 1'b0;                  // LIFO is empty if counter is zero
    assign full  = (lifo_counter == DEPTH)? 1'b1 : 1'b0;               // LIFO is full if counter equals DEPTH

    // Counter logic to track the number of elements in LIFO
    always @(posedge clock) begin
        if (reset) begin
            lifo_counter <= 0;                                          // Reset the counter when reset signal is active
        end else if (!full && write_en) begin
            lifo_counter <= lifo_counter + 1;                           // Increment counter on write if LIFO is not full
        end else if (!empty && read_en) begin
            lifo_counter <= lifo_counter - 1;                           // Decrement counter on read if LIFO is not empty
        end
    end

    // Memory write logic: writes data into the LIFO
    always @(posedge clock) begin
        if (reset) begin
            ptr <= {ADDR_WIDTH {1'b0}};                                  // Reset pointer to zero on reset
        end else if (write_en && !full) begin
            memory[ptr] <= data_in;                                      // Write input data into memory at current pointer
            ptr <= ptr + 1;                                              // Increment pointer to next memory location
        end else if (read_en && !empty) begin
            ptr <= ptr - 1;                                              // Decrement pointer after reading
        end
    end

    // Memory read logic: reads data from the LIFO
    always @(posedge clock) begin
        if (reset) begin
            temp_data_out <= {DATA_WIDTH{1'b0}};                         // Clear output data on reset
        end else if (read_en && !empty) begin
            temp_data_out <= memory[ptr - 1'b1];                         // Read data from memory at (pointer - 1)
        end
    end

    // Error / valid status flags (registered, sampled at the clock edge)
    always @(posedge clock) begin
        if (reset) begin
            error <= 1'b0;                                               // Clear error on reset
            valid <= 1'b0;                                               // No valid data on reset
        end else begin
            // Overflow: write when full. Underflow: read when empty.
            error <= (write_en && full) || (read_en && empty);
            // valid tracks the registered data_out: high the cycle a successful read result appears
            valid <= (read_en && !empty);
        end
    end

    // Assign the output data
    assign data_out = temp_data_out;                                     // Assign temp data output to the actual output
endmodule

`timescale 1ns / 1ps
module sync_serial_communication_tx_rx(
    input clk,                     // Clock signal
    input reset_n,                 // Active low reset signal
    input [2:0] sel,               // Selection signal for TX block
    input [63:0] data_in,          // 64-bit data input for TX block
    output [63:0] data_out,        // 64-bit data output from RX block
    output done,                   // Done signal indicating completion
    output parity_error            // Parity error indication for communication
);

// Internal signals
wire tx_out;                       // Serial data output from TX block
wire tx_done;                      // Done signal from TX block
wire serial_clk_in;                // Serial clock generated by TX block
wire tx_parity;                    // Parity bit generated by TX block

// Instantiate the TX block
tx_block uut_tx_block (
    .clk(clk),                     // Clock input to TX block
    .reset_n(reset_n),             // Reset input to TX block
    .data_in(data_in),             // 64-bit data input to TX block
    .sel(sel),                     // Selection signal to TX block
    .serial_out(tx_out),           // Serial data output from TX block
    .done(tx_done),                // Done signal from TX block
    .serial_clk(serial_clk_in),    // Serial clock output from TX block
    .parity(tx_parity)             // Parity bit output from TX block
);

// Instantiate the RX block
rx_block uut_rx_block (
    .clk(clk),                     // Clock input to RX block
    .serial_clk(serial_clk_in),    // Serial clock input to RX block
    .reset_n(reset_n),             // Reset input to RX block
    .sel(sel),                     // Selection signal to RX block
    .data_in(tx_out),              // Serial data input to RX block
    .parity_in(tx_parity),         // Parity bit input to RX block
    .data_out(data_out),           // 64-bit data output from RX block
    .done(done),                   // Done signal from RX block
    .parity_error(parity_error)    // Parity error output from RX block
);

endmodule

///// tx_block
module tx_block(
    input clk,               // Clock input
    input reset_n,           // Active-low reset input
    input [63:0] data_in,    // 64-bit parallel data input
    input [2:0] sel,         // Selection input to choose data width
    output reg serial_out,   // Serial data output
    output reg done,         // Done signal indicating completion of transmission
    output serial_clk,       // Clock for serial data transmission
    output reg parity        // Parity bit transmitted alongside serialized data
);

// Internal registers
reg [63:0] data_reg;         // Register to hold the data being transmitted
reg [6:0] bit_count;         // Counter to track number of bits to transmit
reg [6:0] reg_count;         // Register for counting bits for serial clock control
reg [6:0] temp_reg_count;    // Temporary register to track reg_count

// Sequential block for state control and data selection
always @(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if (!reset_n) begin
        // Reset all values on active-low reset
        data_reg     <= 64'h0;                                     // Clear the data register
        bit_count    <= 7'h0;                                      // Reset bit count to zero
        reg_count    <= 7'h0;                                      // Reset reg_count to zero
        parity       <= 1'b0;                                      // Reset parity bit
    end else begin
        if (done == 1'b1) begin
            // Case block to determine the width of data to transmit based on the 'sel' input
            case (sel)
                3'b000: begin
                    data_reg  <= 64'h0;                            // No data selected
                    bit_count <= 7'd0;                             // No bits to transmit
                    parity    <= 1'b0;                             // No parity for no data
                end
                3'b001: begin
                    data_reg  <= {56'h0, data_in[7:0]};            // Transmit lowest 8 bits
                    bit_count <= 7'd7;                             // 8 bits to transmit
                    parity    <= ^data_in[7:0];                    // Parity of lowest 8 bits
                end
                3'b010: begin
                    data_reg  <= {48'h0, data_in[15:0]};           // Transmit lowest 16 bits
                    bit_count <= 7'd15;                            // 16 bits to transmit
                    parity    <= ^data_in[15:0];                   // Parity of lowest 16 bits
                end
                3'b011: begin
                    data_reg  <= {32'h0, data_in[31:0]};           // Transmit lowest 32 bits
                    bit_count <= 7'd31;                            // 32 bits to transmit
                    parity    <= ^data_in[31:0];                   // Parity of lowest 32 bits
                end
                3'b100: begin
                    data_reg  <= data_in[63:0];                    // Transmit all 64 bits
                    bit_count <= 7'd63;                            // 64 bits to transmit
                    parity    <= ^data_in[63:0];                   // Parity of all 64 bits
                end
                default: begin
                    data_reg  <= 64'h0;                            // Default case: no data
                    bit_count <= 7'h0;                             // No bits to transmit
                    parity    <= 1'b0;                             // No parity
                end
            endcase

        end else if (bit_count > 7'h0) begin
            data_reg   <= data_reg >> 1;                           // Shift the data to the right
            bit_count  <= bit_count - 1'b1;                        // Decrement the bit count

        end
        reg_count <= bit_count;                                    // Update reg_count for serial clock control
    end
end

// Generate serial clock based on reg_count
assign  #1 serial_clk = clk && (temp_reg_count !== 7'd0) ;  // To avoid Simulator issue

// Register to keep track of reg_count and use for clock gating
always@(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if(!reset_n) begin
        temp_reg_count <= 7'h0;                                    // Reset temporary reg_count
    end
    else begin
        temp_reg_count <= reg_count;                               // Update temp_reg_count with current reg_count
    end
end


// Sequential logic to drive the serial_out signal based on reg_count and bit_count
always@(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if(!reset_n) begin
       serial_out <= 1'b0;                                         // Reset serial output
    end
    else if(reg_count > 7'h0 || bit_count > 7'h0) begin
       serial_out <= data_reg[0];                                  // Output the least significant bit of data_reg
    end
end

// Set the done signal when transmission is complete (bit_count reaches zero)
always@(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
    if(!reset_n) begin
        done <= 1'b0;                                              // Reset done output
    end
    else begin
     if(bit_count == 7'h0) begin
        done <= 1'b1;                                              // Set done signal high when transmission is done
     end
     else begin
        done <= 1'b0;                                              // Clear done signal during transmission
     end
end
end


endmodule

///// rx_block
module rx_block(
    input wire clk,                 // clock input
    input wire reset_n,             // Active-low reset
    input wire data_in,             // Serial input data
    input wire serial_clk,          // Clock signal for serial data
    input wire [2:0] sel,           // Selection output to choose data width
    input wire parity_in,           // Received parity bit
    output reg done,                // Done signal to indicate data reception complete
    output reg [63:0] data_out,     // Parallel output data after serial operation
    output reg parity_error         // Parity mismatch indication during reception

);

    // Internal registers
    reg [63:0] data_reg;            // Register to hold incoming serial data
    reg [7:0] bit_count;            // Counter for the number of bits received
    reg [7:0] count;                // General purpose counter to sync with bit_count


    // Sequential logic block to capture serial data on the rising edge of serial_clk
    always @(posedge serial_clk or negedge  reset_n) begin
        if (!reset_n) begin         // Reset all registers on reset_n (active low)
            data_reg <= 64'h0;      // Clear the data register
            bit_count <= 8'd0;      // Clear the bit counter
        end else begin
            if(done == 1'b1) begin                   // If done signal is asserted, reset the bit counter and data register
                bit_count <= 8'b0;
                data_reg <= 64'h0;
            end
            else begin
                 bit_count <= bit_count;             // Maintain the bit counter if not done
            end
                bit_count <= bit_count + 1'b1;       // Increment bit count
                data_reg[bit_count]<=data_in;        // Store the incoming data bit
           end
    end

    // Sequential logic block to monitor the completion of data reception and update outputs
    always@(posedge clk or negedge reset_n) begin
        if(!reset_n) begin                           // Reset all registers on reset_n (active low)
           count <= 8'd0;                            // Clear the bit counter
           done <= 1'b0;                             // Deassert done signal
           data_out <= 64'h0;                        // Clear the output data register
           parity_error <= 1'b0;                     // Clear parity error flag
        end
        else if(count >= bit_count && count != 8'd0) begin       // When the count reaches the bit_count, assert done and output the data
           done <= 1'b1;                             // Set done to indicate transmission complete
           parity_error <= (parity_in != (^data_reg));  // Compare received parity against computed parity
           case(sel)
            3'b000:begin
                data_out <= 64'h0;                   // no bits to transmit
            end
            3'b001:begin
                data_out <= {56'h0,data_reg};        // 8 bits of data_reg
            end
            3'b010:begin
                data_out <= {48'h0,data_reg};        // 16 bits of data_reg
            end
            3'b011:begin
                data_out <= {32'h0,data_reg};        // 32 bits of data_reg
            end
            3'b100:begin
                data_out <= data_reg;                // 64 bits of data_reg
            end
            default:begin
                data_out <= 64'h0;                   // no bits to transmit, default state
            end
           endcase
        end
        else if(bit_count > 8'd0) begin              // If bits are being received, increment the count and deassert done
           count <= count+ 1'b1;                     // Increment count
           done <= 1'b0;                             // Clear done signal while receiving
        end
        else begin                                   // If no bits have been received, reset the count and deassert done
           count <= 8'd0;                            // Reset count
           done <= 1'b0;                             // Clear done signal
        end
    end

endmodule
